sentences.text:
Author: D.Ramesh
Bench: D.Ramesh
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice D.Ramesh
 Criminal Petition No.3504 of 2020
Order:

This petition is filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 by the petitioners,
who are accused Nos.1 and 2 in Crime No.192 of 2019 on the file of Rentachinthala Police Station,
Guntur District.
The offences alleged are under sections 188, 273, 420, 328 and 120B of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Sections 58 and 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

2. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned Additional Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent.
3. Both the counsel submit that the issue involved in this petition is squarely covered by the order dated 27.08.2018, passed by this Court in Criminal Petition No.3731of 2018 and batch.
4.

In view of the above and in terms of the afore said order, this Criminal petition is allowed and the proceedings against the petitioners in Crime No.192 of 2019 on the file of Rentachinthala Police Station, Guntur District are hereby quashed.

As a sequel thereto, the miscellaneous petitions, if any,
pending in this criminal petition shall stand closed.
5. The Registry is directed to attach a copy of the order in Criminal Petition No.3731of 2018, dated 27.08.2018 to this order.

JUSTICE D.RAMESH Date: 01.9.2020 Note:
Dispatch order copy tomorrow.
